integrity: A complete analytical proof and standalone rational-arithmetic diagnostic checker are included. Finite tests are supplementary. Bibliographic priority is qualified and independent verification is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp real L2-to-L4 norm only on opposite-parity two-mode Chebyshev spans; excludes same-parity cubic interference, complex extremizers and unrestricted Jacobi semigroup hypercontractivity.
title: Three sharp mode-selection regimes for the Jacobi heat semigroup on Chebyshev pairs
